items.definition: 搅起、激起、挑起（风沙／情绪）
items.definitionEn: to cause a substance or feeling to become active or agitated
items.sentence: Individuals in crowds feel anonymous and powerful, leading to destruction and violence; people in a crowd are a grain of sand amid other grains of sand, which the wind stirs up at will.

items.definitionEn: not identified by name; lacking individuality
items.sentence: Individuals in crowds feel anonymous and powerful, leading to destruction and violence; people in a crowd are a grain of sand amid other grains of sand, which the wind stirs up at will.

analysis.trunk: people are a grain of sand
chunks: which the wind stirs up at will
analysis.modifiers: which 引导非限定定语从句，挂在前文的 grains of sand 上；at will 意为「随意地」
analysis.rewrite: 群体里的人只是沙堆中的一粒沙，风想怎么吹就怎么吹 —— 匿名、无力。
analysis.plain: 个人在群体中失去姓名与个性，被群体的力量任意摆布。
